source_title: Xabi Alonso press conference: Chelsea vs Man Utd - BBC
source_excerpt:
Chelsea boss Xabi Alonso has been speaking to the media before Saturday's Premier League game against Manchester United at Stamford Bridge (12:30 GMT).
Here are the key lines from his news conference:
Alonso gave an update on defender Maxence Lacroix, who limped off during Wednesday's Carabao Cup exit at the hands of Liverpool: "Max picked up an injury and we expect he will not be available before the international break. He will be out for a few weeks."
